title: kate-ui: keep catch-up coloring inside the viewport
summary: resume_color_line clamps a hole before the viewport to visible_first when the cursor is inside the viewport. A hole inside the viewport stays. The test goes in the existing highlight tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn resume_color_line(color_at: u32, visible_first: u32, visible_last: u32, plain_line: u32) -> u32

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: The signature above is the function. Keep the existing pub(crate). Do not add an attribute. highlight.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Edit only the branch in resume_color_line where plain_line is less than color_at and the cursor is inside the viewport. Return plain_line.max(visible_first). When the cursor is outside the viewport, still return visible_first. When plain_line is at or after color_at, still return color_at. Do not touch highlight_step, PAINT_LINE_BUDGET, CATCH_UP_LINE_BUDGET, or COLOR_LINE_BUDGET. The test resume_color_line_clamps_a_hole_to_the_viewport calls resume_color_line(20, 10, 50, 0) and expects 10. resume_color_line(24, 0, 40, 10) still returns 10. resume_color_line(24, 0, 40, 30) still returns 24. resume_color_line(40, 0, 40, 20) still returns 0. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::resume_color_line_clamps_a_hole_to_the_viewport
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. resume_color_line(20, 10, 50, 0) returns 0. After the change it returns 10. A hole at line 10 inside 0..40 with the cursor at 24 still returns 10. A later plain line at 30 still returns 24. A cursor at the exclusive end still returns 0.
